readme.title: Magic Caster Wand for Home Assistant

descriptions.en: A Home Assistant custom integration that connects Harry Potter Magic Caster Wands and their boxes over Bluetooth. Spells and buttons trigger automations, and Home Assistant can send LED and vibration effects back to the wand.
descriptions.ko: 해리 포터 Magic Caster Wand와 보관함을 Bluetooth로 연결하는 Home Assistant 커스텀 통합입니다. 주문과 버튼으로 자동화를 실행하고 지팡이에 LED·진동 효과를 보낼 수 있습니다.

categories_review.source: README.md: physical Magic Caster Wand gestures and button presses trigger Home Assistant automations; wand/box LEDs and vibration provide feedback. Primary product use is an automation remote, so buttons_remotes; no secondary category inferred from entity platforms.
